name: Splash Lasher
description: Offspring {1}{U}. When this creature enters, tap up to one target creature and put a stun counter on it.
couldNotDerive: That the stun counter goes on the tapped target, not this creature -- Defined$Targeted resolves to thing:self instead (same Defined$<sibling-reference> family gap).
notes: Found and fixed a real bug: Offspring's multi-symbol cost bracing was wrong -- "1 U" (space-separated, Forge's own mana notation) got wrapped in ONE brace pair ("{1 U}", invalid mana notation) instead of two ("{1}{U}"). Only ever surfaced on multi-symbol Offspring costs (single-symbol costs like "3"/"1" looked identical either way). Fixed by reusing forgeScript.ts's own space-to-braces conversion. One narrower gap remains: PutCounter's Defined$Targeted ("put a stun counter on IT") resolves to self instead of the tapped creature, same already-documented family.
